format: HTML with embedded template and JavaScript
description: Template file for editing banners in the Revive Adserver admin interface, including form handling, conditional notices, and TinyMCE editor initialization.

methods.name: selectFile
methods.description: Handles file selection, sets checkbox to 't'.

methods.name: oa_sizeChangeUpdateMessage
methods.description: Shows or hides size change warning messages based on banner dimensions.

methods.name: oa_show
methods.description: Displays an HTML element by ID.

methods.name: oa_hide
methods.description: Hides an HTML element by ID.

methods.name: rv_tinymce
methods.description: Initializes or removes TinyMCE editor on a selector, with optional image URL prefix replacement.
